419:t_2:35.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$カレン$$. $$宗介$$ is reining in my elation.」

419:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you intend to do, $n?」

419:t_2:37.en:
$n
「...I don't know what to do right now.」

419:t_2:38.en:
$n
「But no matter what it takes, I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$.」

419:t_2:39.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... I can't leave rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$ to you alone.」

419:t_2:40.en:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is the Volunteer Club's madonna, after all.」

419:t_2:41.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$, $$アマタ$$ and the others will get fired up about rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$, too, I bet.」

419:t_2:42.en:
$n
「Then we do it with everyone's strength. No matter what tricks $$バルビエル$$ pulls.」

419:t_2:43.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Now it's getting fun! Do your best, everyone!」

419:t_2:44.en:
$n
(Not clinging to convenient hopes, and not lashing out in despair either... Just doing what I have to do...)

419:t_2:45.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$... For me, that means rescuing you.)

419:t_2:46.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Still, I was surprised. I never thought $$ランド$$ had worries or anxieties.」

419:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「Adults don't show that kind of thing on the outside.」

419:t_2:48.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Maybe so. $$ジャミル$$ was the same.」

419:t_2:49.en:
$$パーラ$$
「So adults... aren't just people who drink and act all high and mighty toward the young.」

419:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... guess we need to blow off steam.」

419:t_2:51.en:
$$メール$$
「What are you saying, Darling! All that steam you blow off guzzling beer is why our business is in the red every single time!」

419:t_2:52.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't be so angry, $$メール$$. If you keep talking about money, you'll make $$ランド$$ feel bad.」

419:t_2:54.en:
$n
「For $$ランド$$'s smile, you've got to put up with a little spending.」

419:t_2:55.en:
$$メール$$
「No fair! You're trying to sweet-talk me four against one!」

419:t_2:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A lovely show of mutual aid between Reactors.」

419:t_2:57.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「So everyone's on the same level.」

419:t_2:59.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No need to thank us. You showed us how to get over the wall.」

419:t_2:61.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... The nameless anxiety that you and $n feel is inside me as well.」

419:t_2:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like that's why the last door on our machines won't open.」

419:t_2:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not only do we have to dread the backlash, but this comes along with it? That's excess service, $$スフィア$$...」

419:t_2:68.en:
$n
「I was thinking I'd follow $$ランド$$'s example and try hard too.」

419:t_2:69.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the spirit, kid! You walk the road to being a grown man too!」

419:t_2:71.en:
$n
(If the anxiety is a phenomenon unique to Reactors, then what was Miss $$スズネ$$ so afraid of...)

419:t_2:72.en:
$n
(Does it have something to do with how she stopped feeling anxious right before she was taken...)

419:t_2:73.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「All right, everyone! Today is $c's farewell party!」

419:t_2:74.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A welcome party the other day, and now a farewell party already!」

419:t_2:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Parties? I'd welcome one every single day!」

419:t_2:80.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Effort, guts, fighting spirit, and sheer hot-bloodedness... Are these guys all in the same group...?」

419:t_2:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's enjoy it too, Big Sis! It's a rare chance for a party, after all.」

419:t_2:82.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You're right. It's not bad that this beautiful green sea has become peaceful.」

419:t_2:83.en:
$$メルティ$$
「We'll prepare plenty of food, too!」

419:t_2:84.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Of course, our dancing will be there too.」

419:t_2:85.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is $$ティファ$$ going to dance again, too!?」

419:t_2:87.en:
$$ガロード$$
「All right!! Three cheers for the party!!」

419:t_2:89.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even if an octopus shows up, don't draw your gun this time, $$レド$$.」

419:t_2:91.en:
$n
「Is that something $$宗介$$ should be saying...」

419:t_2:92.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$c ships out tomorrow! Tonight, we drink!」

419:t_2:94.en:
$$レド$$
「Yeah... And someday, let's come back to $$ガルガンティア$$.」

419:t_2:95.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yeah...! When that time comes, we'll definitely be together, $$レド$$.」

419:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...What the heck is that $$エルーナルーナ$$ thing...」

419:t_10:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I never could have imagined it back when she was wrapped in armor.」

419:t_10:5.en:
$n
「No matter how great her command ability is, I can see why people would judge that 'with that at the head of the military...'」

419:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I sympathized a little with $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ just now.」

419:t_10:7.en:
$n
「I feel for $$ランド$$, who's going to have her hounding him.」

419:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, everyone... you all seem to have mixed feelings about $$エルーナルーナ$$'s appearance, but it moved every one of your hearts greatly.」

419:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ produced by that come to 100 Z! I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

419:t_10:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「AG, if you take off your armor, is there... inside you too? That's not the case, is it?」

419:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How lewd~. So that's what you're thinking, peeling off my armor?」

419:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I'm only a robot after all...」

419:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not some surprise box with a glamorous beauty inside, like that one.」

419:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly, $n. Don't go having any indecent fantasies about me.」

419:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-ah... Please spare me the $$ブーストアップ$$ punishment...!」
